outcome: Antibiotic prescriptions (as a proxy for mild-to-moderate infections)
cohort: The cohort consisted of all children born to women with multiple sclerosis in Denmark between 1995 and 2023, identified through national health registers.
finding: Children born preterm to mothers with multiple sclerosis had an increased risk of hospital-diagnosed infections in the first 3 years of life, but not of mild-to-moderate infections, while children born small for gestational age did not have an increased risk of infections.
